speech_minutes: 2.4

# The Shoreline Hut

This session is not for listening to while driving or doing anything that needs your full attention. [PAUSE 3 s]

Welcome. You might keep your eyes open or closed, whichever feels right. You might rest your attention on the sounds around you, as an anchor, or simply on the feeling of your hands. [PAUSE 5 s]

At any point, you are welcome to pause, open your eyes or stop listening. Nothing is expected of you. [SILENCE 10 s]

Picture a pale beach in soft morning light, where the sand is warm and the shallows are clear and gentle. If it feels okay, you might notice a path of smooth stones leading up to an open hut with a wide doorway. [PAUSE 4 s]

You walk slowly along the shoreline. The water laps at the sand, and gulls drift far overhead. If your mind wanders, that is perfectly normal, and you can simply come back to the light on the water. [SILENCE 15 s]

Halfway through, a gentle reminder. You can pause, open your eyes or stop at any time, and come back whenever you like. [PAUSE 4 s]

You reach the hut and hold your
breath in the sun on a wooden bench in the sun. You might feel the grain of the wood under your hands, and hear the tide in the distance. [SILENCE 20 s]

Now it is time to return, gradually. Notice your feet on the floor, or your seat on the chair. If it feels okay, notice three sounds in the room. [PAUSE 5 s]

Gently move your fingers and toes. Then open your eyes in your own time, when you are ready. [PAUSE 3 s]
